profile.headline: Kdb+ software developer at Citadel Securities

positions.title: Software Engineer - kdb+ consultant
positions.description: I am a kdb+ consultant after completing First Derivatives graduate programme. Consulting with a Tier 1 investment Bank in New York since 2017

positions.title: Receptionist & Attendant
positions.description:
Provided excellent customer service. Checked guests in and out of rooms. Took payment
from guests. Answered guest inquires. Also answered the phones to create/edit/cancel
a booking. Checked-ins of large school groups. Also drove guests to their rooms, lifted
bags up to the rooms. Brought luggage to storage when required. Also spent nights on-call
for late check-ins of guests who arrive after closing hours and to handle guests that were
disturbing other guests during the night.

positions.title: Sales Assistant
positions.description:
Worked as a member of a team compromising of up to 30 people. Worked on till serving
wide range of customers and created complex ice-cream dazzlers and other ice-cream food
items. Also cleaned and organised the stock and emptied the rubbish.

positions.title: Claims Handler
positions.description:
Summer Internship

Handled and resolved outstanding excess windscreen claims. Required to contact customers,
repair garages and solicitors within a specified time frame and ensure all claims were closed
to both the customers and company’s satisfaction.

positions.title: Barman
positions.description:
Provided excellent customer service. Multi tasked to take orders, make and serve drinks,
ensure payment was received and provide customers satisfaction. Also responsible for
cleaning and restocking the bar and ensuring bar was clean and tidy at the end of the night.
